deviations.what: t2's criterion 'an existing symlink at the target name fails path_refused before any request is sent' is met after the read instead: the target name (sha256 plus extension) is known only once the body is read, so the request is sent and the body streamed to a temp file in the root; then path_refused fires, nothing is written through the symlink, and the temp file is removed (tested, including that the symlink's destination is never created). The other three refusals (outside save_roots, a symlinked root, no save_roots) still happen before any request
deviations.reason: the file is named by the sha256 of its body, which does not exist before the request
